sources.title: [2511.21631] Qwen3-VL Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We introduce Qwen3-VL, the most capable vision-language model in the Qwen series to date, achieving superior performance across a broad range of multimodal benchmarks. It natively supports interleaved contexts of up to 256K tokens, seamlessly integrating text, images, and video. sources.snippet: This is Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B quantized with AutoRound to W4A16 (INT). The model is compatible with vLLM (tested: v0.16.1rc1). Tested with an H200. Currently under evaluation.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
